description: Retrieve comprehensive runtime & debugging metrics: CDP counters (JSHeapUsedMB, Nodes, JSEventListeners, LayoutCount, ScriptDuration), Core Web Vitals (TTFB, FCP, LCP + target element, CLS + shifting elements, TBT + long tasks), Resource bottlenecks (slowest & render-blocking URLs), DOM/A11y health (max depth, duplicate IDs, missing alt/labels), and automated diagnostic warnings.

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

includeDomHealth.description: Collect DOM depth, duplicate IDs, and accessibility health metrics (default: true)

includeResources.description: Collect resource bottleneck metrics (slowest & render-blocking URLs) (default: true)

includeWebVitals.description: Collect Core Web Vitals (TTFB, FCP, LCP, CLS, TBT) (default: true)
